The learned counsel for the petitioner filed a memo dated 05.09.2024 and the same reads as under:
"The undersigned hereby submits that, since the respondent police have filed the charge sheet, the petitioner is seeking liberty to withdraw the above petition with liberty to file fresh petition among other grounds due to the bona fide reasons, in the interest of justice"
2.
